All patients will be screened for eligibility by a trained screener.
Patients receiving an anti-osteoporotic treatment will be excluded from the study.
Patients requiring an anti-osteoporotic baseline treatment (T-score ⩽ -3DS on at least 1 site or FRAX score above the therapeutic intervention threshold) will be excluded from the study.
Patients with one or more major risk factors for osteoporosis will be included in the study.
Patients who have received topical corticosteroids in less than 3 months will be excluded from the study.
